decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 down at N600-09 (radio+CMMS agree, likely repair 13:20). Norte is already truck-limited (inflow 71 t/h vs trucks 66 t/h, stockpile 238 t of 450), so the trucks already haul at capacity and an extra loader adds no ounces. Lending LH-08 (0.2 oz/h) would also cost home development for no gain. Other mines have no free loaders and no stopped stope to activate a reserve. Keep the status quo and re-evaluate if the repair estimate slips.
